# Lightweight versioned GitLab Pages

Generate index page with links to all previously archived folders during a tag
build

---------------

## Installation

```bash
pip install lightweight-versioned-gitlab-pages
```

## Usage

### Help

```bash
generate-versioned-pages --help
```

### Generate lightweight versioned pages

The following command will create a folder named `public` at the current
location and place an index HTML file inside.

This index file contains a very basic Bootstrap cards list with all previously
built tags and the URL to the public pages archive files

```bash
generate-versioned-pages --private_token asdf-carlTheLamaIsHere --project-id 43170198 --job-name pages
```

```{eval-rst}
.. warning::
    A tag will be listed even if there has been no public folder archived.
```

```{note}
This repo and package is under construction! Fixes and improvements are on the
way.
```
